subject: If exposure, identity, or outcome linkage cannot be established for cases, no effect should be inferred from those cases.
rationale: Within the stated scope of inference requiring those links, failure to establish a necessary link prevents warranted attribution of an effect to the case. S004 supports the dependence of attribution on provenance, and S006 makes its strength dependent on recording reliability. This justifies withholding the dependent inference; it does not establish absence of an effect or require exclusion for every documentation gap.
